reason: B is the stronger proposal because it defines a single Mn-containing baseline, controlled exposure, oxidation-kinetics and damage measurements, and a clearer correlation-based falsification test. Its lattice-coherence premise is still weak—protective Al/Si oxides are more plausibly governed by selective oxidation, slow diffusion, and scale adhesion than persistent oxide/metal lattice matching—but A is less controlled and relies even more vaguely on an unsubstantiated mixed-oxide compatibility mechanism.
